sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IX OF 1992
ACT IX OF 1992
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (PAYMENT OF DEARNESS ALLOWANCE TO CERTAIN
EMPLOYEES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to amend the
North-West Frontier Province (Payment of Dearness Allowance to Certain
Employees Act 1991
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 27th September, 1992]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis/92/19456-57,
dated 27-9-1992: -The North West Frontier Province (Payment of Dearness
Allowance to Certain Employees) (Amendment) Bill, 1992, having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province on the 15th
September, 1992 and assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier
Province on the 23rd September, 1992 is hereby published as an Act
of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
North-West Frontier Province (Payment of Dearness Allowance to Certain
Employees) (Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) Section 4 shall come into
force at once and the remaining provisions of this Act shall be deemed to have
taken effect on the 1st day of December, 1990.

2. Amendment of section 2 of N.-W.F.P. Act (II of 1991).-In the

An Act further to amend the
North-West Frontier Province (Payment of Dearness Allowance to Certain
Employees Act 1991
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 27th September, 1992]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis/92/19456-57,
dated 27-9-1992: -The North West Frontier Province (Payment of Dearness
Allowance to Certain Employees) (Amendment) Bill, 1992, having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province on the 15th
September, 1992 and assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier
Province on the 23rd September, 1992 is hereby published as an Act
of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
3. Amendment of section 3 of N.-W.F.P. Act (II of 1991).--In the
said Act, for section 3 the following shall be substituted and shall always be
deemed to have been so substituted, namely:-- .
"3.
Dearness Allowance.-Every employee shall, with effect from the 1st day of
December, 1990, be paid by his employer a dearness allowance--
(a) equal to
two hundred rupees per month, if his monthly wages in respect of his employment
do not exceed four thousand rupees; or
(b) at such
rates, as, together with his wages in respect of his employment, make a total
of four thousand and two hundred rupees per month, if his wages exceed four
thousand rupees per month, but does not exceed four thousand and two hundred
rupees per month."

[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 27th September, 1992]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis/92/19456-57,
dated 27-9-1992: -The North West Frontier Province (Payment of Dearness
Allowance to Certain Employees) (Amendment) Bill, 1992, having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province on the 15th
September, 1992 and assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier
Province on the 23rd September, 1992 is hereby published as an Act
of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
4. Amendment of section 8 of N. W.F.P. Act (II of 1991).-In the
said Act, for section 8, the following shall be substituted namely:--
"8.
Penalty.--Any employer who fails to pay the dearness allowance admissible to
any employee under this Act shall be punishable with simple imprisonment for a
term which may extend to six months or with fine which shall not be less than
two thousand rupees per employee in the undertaking concerned or with
both.".

said Act, for section 9, the following shall be substituted and shall always be
deemed to have been so substituted, namely.-
"9. Cognizance.-The Court shall not take
cognizance of an offence under this Act save on a complaint made by an
aggrieved employee or by an office-bearer of a registered trade union of which
such employee is a member, or by an Inspector, having jurisdiction in the area,
appointed under section 10(1) of the Factories Act, 1934 (Act XXV of
1934).".
